fields.requestedAt: When the reset was asked for, e.g. 19 Nov 2026, 14:05 EAT.
fields.device: Optional. Browser and system the request came from, e.g. Chrome on Android.
fields.signInHost: Sign-in address without https:// for display.
fields.securityUrl: The Security page, where sessions can be revoked.
fields.mfaEnrolled: true when the account uses two-step sign-in.
